text: I think you'll really enjoy this Grilled Chicken and Pasta Salad recipe! It's a great option for you because it features chicken, which you mentioned you like, and it's made with relatively healthy ingredients. The pasta and spinach add some carbs and fiber, while the green grapes and cranberries provide natural sweetness. The best part is that it's low in saturated fat, which aligns with your health goal. Plus, it's quick to make and can be ready in under 30 minutes, fitting within your time budget.
